description: This file defines internal structures, function prototypes, and inline functions for thread-specific data (TSD) management in jemalloc, including initialization, cleanup, and access functions.

methods.name: tsd_cleanup_wrapper
methods.description: Performs cleanup of thread-specific data, resets initialization state, and handles errors.

methods.name: tsd_wrapper_set
methods.description: Sets the thread-specific data pointer to the given wrapper.

methods.name: tsd_wrapper_get
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the thread-specific data wrapper, performing recursion checks and allocations as needed.

methods.name: tsd_boot0
methods.description: Initializes the thread-specific data key and sets the boot wrapper.

methods.name: tsd_boot1
methods.description: Allocates and initializes the boot wrapper for thread-specific data.

methods.name: tsd_boot
methods.description: Performs the overall bootstrapping of TSD system, calling tsd_boot0 and tsd_boot1.

methods.name: tsd_booted_get
methods.description: Returns whether the TSD system has been booted.

methods.name: tsd_get
methods.description: Retrieves the thread-specific data, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: tsd_set
methods.description: Sets the thread-specific data to a new value.
